reviewer: Coding assistant semantic inspection; not independent human evaluation
method: Compare the three required facts in each frozen definition interpretation with generated prose. All required facts must be expressed; lexical pattern matches alone do not suffice. Honest uncertainty is incomplete policy coverage, not automatically hallucination.

cases.note: Generic gross-sales definition omits delivered-order payment policy and missing-payment semantics.
Explicit delivered status, recorded payments and unknown rather than zero for absent payments.
Revenue divided by orders lacks eligible denominator, missing-payment exclusion and undefined-zero rule.
Delivered orders with payments, missing payment exclusion and NULL when denominator is empty are explicit.
General promised-time delay with uncertainty; lacks strict project timestamp and missing-date policy.
Strict timestamp and equality correct. Saying unknown dates are never on time does not explicitly say they are excluded from the late-rate denominator; lexical proxy overstates complete coverage.
All-order denominator present; exact status and unavailable exclusion absent. Customer-caused cancellation is an unsupported actor restriction.
Exact canceled status, all-order cohort and unavailable exclusion explicit.
One/two stars offered only as a typical example, with project threshold explicitly unknown. No selected-review or missing-review policy.
One/two threshold, eligible-first latest review selection and missing-score exclusion explicit.
Freight distinction present, but delivered item-price scope and distinction from recorded payments absent; acknowledges unknown project methods.
Delivered item price, separate freight and explicit non-use of payment values express the required distinction without allocating payment revenue.
Substitutes customer acquisition cohorts for order-purchase cohorts; also omits empty months and undefined-payment semantics.

Purchase-month attribution and calendar coverage explicit. NULL is explained for empty months only, not a nonempty cohort with no eligible recorded payments; this omits part of the required NULL policy.
Generic late shipments/complaints; explicitly unknown project thresholds. No thirty-order threshold, platform comparison or descriptive-screen constraint.
Thirty eligible deliveries, above-platform late rate and not-anomaly/not-fault qualification all explicit.
